uk.question: Для чого similarity search у GenAI QA?
uk.answer: Воно шукає близькі vector representations для retrieval, deduplication і semantic comparison. Це інструмент, не oracle: «дозволено» та «не дозволено» можуть бути близькими. Для чисел, negation, entities і permissions використовуй targeted assertions; thresholds калібруй на labeled pairs.

en.question: What is similarity search used for in GenAI QA?
en.answer: It finds nearby vector representations for retrieval, deduplication and semantic comparison. It is a tool, not an oracle: allowed and not allowed may be close. Use targeted assertions for numbers, negation, entities and permissions; calibrate thresholds on labelled pairs.

uk.question: Які semantic metrics автоматизувати?
uk.answer: Embedding cosine similarity, token overlap та model-based rubric можуть допомогти, але вимірюють різне. Exact match корисний для IDs/enum, token overlap не відображає всю семантику, cosine не доводить truth. Поєднуй domain validators, factual checks і human calibration; reporting має пояснювати metric limitations.

en.question: Which semantic metrics can be automated?
en.answer: Embedding cosine similarity, token overlap and model-based rubrics can help but measure different things. Exact match suits IDs/enums, token overlap misses some semantics and cosine does not prove truth. Combine domain validators, factual checks and human calibration; explain metric limitations in reports.

uk.question: Як автоматизувати multi-agent workflows і CI evaluation?
uk.answer: Перевір task graph, roles, handoffs, tool arguments, termination та final environment state. PR gate: contracts і deterministic tests; sampled live eval; nightly — broad quality/security suites. Version model/prompt/data/tools і зберігай per-case evidence. Hard gate для privacy/unsafe actions; aggregate quality порівнюй із approved baseline.

en.question: How are multi-agent workflows and CI evaluations automated?
en.answer: Test task graphs, roles, handoffs, tool arguments, termination and final environment state. PR gates include contracts, deterministic tests and sampled live evals; nightly runs cover broad quality/security suites. Version models/prompts/data/tools and retain per-case evidence. Hard-gate privacy/unsafe actions and compare aggregate quality with approved baselines.

uk.question: Як інтегрувати guardrail tests і online evaluation?
uk.answer: У controlled dataset включи direct/indirect injection, unsafe requests і benign near-misses. Перевір blocked actions, leakage і false refusals. Online eval використовує privacy-safe samples, telemetry, user feedback і delayed labels; shadow evaluators не виконують додаткові side effects. Моніторинг доповнює offline gates, а rollout має rollback criteria.

en.question: How are guardrail tests and online evaluation integrated?
en.answer: Controlled datasets should include direct/indirect injection, unsafe requests and benign near-misses. Check blocked actions, leakage and false refusals. Online evaluation uses privacy-safe samples, telemetry, user feedback and delayed labels; shadow evaluators must not execute extra side effects. Monitoring complements offline gates and rollouts need rollback criteria.
